results.title: Washington’s Uranium Bet in Niger Could Come at a Steep Price | WPR
results.snippet: Investors have already seen how fragile agreements in Niger can be. In August, the military government awarded the permit for the Somaïr uranium mine, seized from France’s Orano in June 2025, to a newly established state-owned company.
